communication_goal: 区分估算工作量与承诺截止时间，并留出测试时间。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Make named learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI marks allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers standing beside a large wall calendar, central slightly above a small desk. Calendar has plain binding and a clear seven-column by five-row date grid, no numerals or weekday letters. One person points at an unnumbered date cell, other holds open palm discussing timing. Keep entire calendar perimeter visible and hands out of the grid. No other charts.

coverage_review.scope: W024 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

image_review.summary: 通过：两人讨论工时与截止时间，中央实体墙历具有装订与七列四行空白日期格；画面不展示具体星期或日期，周五和两天工作量来自对白。整张日历边界完整，少量指点手势不遮挡主体。
